(Made by Layawn)

Pick a style to display your grading :) More styles coming soon!!

name: Hardcore mode
description:
Hardcore Mode implements a Kade Engine type accuracy system.
Hitting sustain notes no longer heals, missing takes more damage and hitting notes badly will also take damage now.
(Scripted by FelixBand)

name: Awesome CRT filter
description:
Adds a cool CRT filter for pixelated stages to emulate the visuals of that era.
(Made by FelixBand)
